scope: Repository completeness and reproducibility. A tracked-source export plus the repository-only changes was installed and built without private environment files. Public page/denial checks used a disposable local database and fixture-only Auth configuration. This is not a hosted deployment, provider evaluation or independent usability study.

sourceHygiene.ocrLimit: On-device text recognition can miss stylized, obscured or low-resolution text. It is not a guarantee that every pixel was interpreted.

limits: The full guard-mutation suite was not rerun; payment and privacy implementation was unchanged.
No new live PayPal, Supabase sign-in or Astropods inference checks were performed. Existing dated records and the recorded demo retain their own scopes.
Hosted partial-failure recovery and independent friend-group usability remain outside this verification.
